given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner is at the primary credential entry screen and has entered valid credentials for their Customer Profile.
given_when_then.when: The system validates the primary credentials successfully.
given_when_then.then: The system issues a one-time verification code via the secondary channel (SMS or email) associated with the Customer Profile.

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner is at the secondary verification step, having just received a valid one-time verification code.
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner enters the received code within its validity duration.
given_when_then.then: The system grants access to the Delivery Partner.

success_criteria: The system transmits the verification code to the registered secondary channel immediately upon primary credential validation success.
The system does not grant access until the valid secondary verification code is entered and matches the issued code.
The system rejects access if the entered code does not match the issued code or has expired.
The system does not issue a secondary verification code if the primary credentials are invalid.
